messages:
infra-bot: CI failed: microbench/kvcache_hitrate on PR #11234 (windows:gpu). Logs: https://ci.redwood/11234/jobs/7 :warning:

maria: saw the alert — kv hit_rate dropped ~18% on the benchmark when running seq_len=256 load. tail latency up ~220ms.

chen: ugh, this smells like a warmup/regression rather than kernel perf. Any recent merges touching batcher or kv-eviction?

jeff: bisected locally to commit c7a9f2a (batcher: prefer_early_flush flag change). Reproduces on my linux-xpu perf runner.

kira: @jeff can you paste the microbench output? also did you try toggling prefer_early_flush?

jeff: sure — snippet from bench:
```
Benchmark: kvcache_hit_rate_seq256
Baseline: hit_rate=0.86 median_latency=11.3ms
PR11234: hit_rate=0.70 median_latency=12.1ms tail_p99=245ms
cmd: ./tools/bench --name=kvcache_hit --seq=256 --iters=5000
```

maria: that p99 jump is what concerned product. We need root cause before merging rollback. Could be eviction threshold or batch timer interacting with kernel selection.

chen: I profiled a short run — KV misses spike during first 200 tokens. Flamegraph shows a lot of time in batcher::flush_wait and kernel_selector::choose_kernel. link: https://perf.redwood/fg/11234

alex: quick repro script (docker):
```
docker run --rm -e RW_ENV=ci redwood/bench:latest \
  /bench/kvcache --model=llama2-7b --seq=256 --concurrency=8 --warmup=50 --iter=2000
```
Run that with/without prefer_early_flush to compare.

kira: I ran that with prefer_early_flush=false — hit_rate jumps back to 0.85 and p99 drops ~190ms. Looks like the flag reduces effective prefix reuse because batches flush earlier and evict KV entries faster.

chen: so the change reduced average batch size which increased kernel selector churn and prevented cache coalescing. Nice catch.

maria: action items: (1) revert c7a9f2a on the merge window until we have a fix, (2) add a microbench that asserts kv hit_rate > 0.80 for seq256 load, (3) add a small perf test toggling early flush permutations.

jeff: filed PR to revert (PR#11241) and added unit to CI; waiting on infra approval.

kira: also adding an observability metric: batch_flush_reason and eviction_cause to help correlate in prod. I'll open a tiny change.

alex: optional mitigation: tune eviction window (increase kv_retention_ms) to reduce churn while we redesign the flush heuristic. We should test cost impact though.

maria: thanks team. @infra-bot can you hold off auto-merge until PR#11241 lands? :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Auto-merge gated: PR#11234 flagged for perf rollback. Merge disabled until manual approval. :lock:

chen: will follow up with a writeup once we prototype a better flush heuristic and kernel affinity smoothing.

jeff: note for the changelog: behavioural perf regression (batcher early flush) -> revert + improved test coverage.

maria: closing loop: if anyone finds a smaller reproducer or an oddity in different seq lengths ping here. Thanks! :rocket:
